spec2def(verifier.dll verifier.spec)

# verifier.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/verifier-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(verifier_shims OBJECT verifier.c)
target_link_libraries(verifier_shims PRIVATE libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(verifier_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(verifier verifier-cargo verifier.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS verifier_shims)
